verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native scheduler, cron, or recurring-job feature in E2B. Background command execution, pause/resume persistence, timeouts, and lifecycle webhooks are one-off or event-driven capabilities, not recurring schedules. A user could trigger sandboxes from an external scheduler, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
